This is first anticipatory bail application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C filed by the applicant who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.139/2024, registered at Police Station- M.P.Nagar, District Bhopal(MP) for the offence punishable under Sections 376 and 376(2)(N) of IPC.
2.
It is the submission of learned counsel for applicant that applicant apprehending his arrest on the basis of registration of offence as referred above.
It is further submitted that applicant and prosecutrix shared emotional and physical proximity with consent and it appers that on her own volition she was in relationship with applicant.
When relationship turned soured then, result is registration of offence referred above.
Infact families of both the parties were in dialogue for solemenization of marriage between the two but somehow it could not be materialised.
To exert pressure this case has been registered.
